subject: Resolution to End Out-of-School Suspensions
overview: The subcommittee debated a resolution to phase out out-of-school suspensions by the 2021-2022 school year. After discussing racial disparities in discipline and safety concerns, the body approved an amended version that requires a comprehensive program review and annual reporting.

items.title: Resolution on the Disciplinary Practice of Suspension
items.summary: Chair Paul Ruseau introduced a resolution to eliminate out-of-school suspensions by the 2021 school year, citing data showing that Black and high-needs students are disproportionately removed from the classroom. Administrators and staff raised concerns about maintaining school safety in cases involving weapons or violence and requested a comprehensive program evaluation before implementing a total ban.

items.title: Resolution Approval and Referral
items.summary: Approved the resolution as amended to include a district-wide review of disciplinary practices, annual reporting to the committee, and language allowing for suspensions permitted by state law. The matter was referred to the full School Committee.
